title: dichanthelium dichotomum var. ensifolium
intro: Dichanthelium dichotomum var. ensifolium, commonly known as var. ensifolium of the Dichanthelium dichotomum grass, is a type of wild grass native to North America. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dichanthelium dichotomum var. ensifolium include its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help ease coughs and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
